verdict.rationale: BVNK documents Travel Rule handling by name: a compliance webhook fires when extra information is needed to satisfy the Travel Rule for a crypto payment. Nothing in the pack names sanctions screening or wallet/address risk checks. Customer status-change webhooks (INFO_REQUIRED/VERIFIED/REJECTED) relate to onboarding, not this machinery. Missing for 10: documented sanctions screening, documented wallet/blockchain address risk checks, in-depth Travel Rule workflow docs beyond the webhook trigger, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform documents its sanctions screening, wallet risk checks, and travel-rule handling — compliance machinery named specifically, not waved at

citations.quote: Triggered when additional information is required to comply with the Travel Rule for a related crypto payment.
